intent: Show today's gaming budget in the i3 bar: time left, used/total, and which bonuses (workout, LeetCode, reading) can still be earned.
scope: Non-goal: no changes to steam-backlog-enforcer, screen-locker, leetcode-guard or book-guard; the block only reads /api/budget
changes: New interval=30 block reads steam-backlog-enforcer GET /api/budget with one curl + one jq pass; colours follow the enforcer warn_at (1h yellow, 30m orange, 10m/blocked red)
Unearned-bonus sizes come from ~/.config/steam_backlog_enforcer/config.json via jq --slurpfile (never on argv, the file holds secrets), falling back to the enforcer defaults 2h/1h/1h
Never blank: dead server shows cached text marked (stale) in orange or 'budget server down' in red; bad state_status, ok:false and unparseable bodies are red and do not overwrite the cache
Behaviour test with a PATH-stubbed curl, wired into the shell-tests CI list

verification.evidence: Live API: '🎮 2h00 left · 6h00/8h00 +📖1h' / '🎮 2h00' / #50FA7B, matching /api/budget (21600s used of 28800, reading bonus 0)
User confirmed the block renders in the bar as intended
All gaming_budget checks passed (thresholds, blocked, overspent, config bonus sizes, stale, down, error states)
All i3blocks efficiency regression tests passed

risks: Depends on the /api/budget JSON shape (today.*, rules.bonuses.*); a renamed field renders 'unreadable budget' in red rather than a wrong number
Bonus fallback sizes duplicate the enforcer defaults; they only matter when config.json leaves the fields unset
rollback: git revert the commit and remove ~/.config/i3blocks/gaming_budget.sh symlink
i3-msg restart and confirm the bar renders without the block
